text:
[Council File 23-0838]
Project Restore report relative to a Fiscal Year 2027-28 funding request for the restoration and Centennial Celebration to commemorate the 100th anniversary of Los Angeles City Hall.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Yes

None submitted
summary: Project Restore asks for Fiscal Year 2027-28 funding to restore Los Angeles City Hall and hold a centennial celebration marking the building's 100th anniversary.
